claims.assertion: Robert recounts meeting an older woman at Montserrat’s ufology congress; she said she was a long-time contactee and introduced him to people she identified as Taygetans, including Swaruu.
claims.speaker: Robert
claims.qualifiers: The Taygetan identity is reported by the narrators.

claims.assertion: Gosia says her first connection with Swaruu was in December, followed by a months-long interruption and renewed contact around April.
claims.speaker: Gosia

claims.assertion: Gosia says Swaruu explained that Taygetans shifted from telepathy to computer chat, which she described as less vulnerable to interference and distortion.
claims.speaker: Gosia, relaying Swaruu
